Get to know me

About Me

A little about my academic journey and interests.

Hello, I'm Priyadharshini Sivasankar, an MSc Data Science student at SASTRA Deemed to be University, Thanjavur, with an undergraduate background in Computer Science.

I enjoy exploring datasets, finding patterns, preparing data, training machine-learning models and communicating results through visualizations and interactive applications. My projects span predictive analytics, fraud detection, healthcare image classification, sales analysis and natural-language processing.

I am particularly interested in Data Analyst, Product Analyst and Business Analyst opportunities where analytical thinking, curiosity about user needs and data-driven decision-making come together. I keep strengthening my technical foundation through hands-on projects and iterative model evaluation.

What I bring A practical learning mindset, structured problem-solving, and a focus on turning analysis into clear, actionable insights.
